# VC-HB-3000

This part is obsolete. Do not load a STEP for it.

The Kendrion INTORQ BFK457-10 Compact was the previous selection.
Its holding torque is 16 Nm.
At a ratio of 40 that is 640 Nm at the gearbox output.
PLE120 T2Stop at i = 40 is 500 Nm.
The brake can exceed that stop torque.
The Siemens 1FL2104 holding brake is used instead.
See `docs/engineering/LIFT-DRIVE-SIZING.md`.

The Compact STEP file was removed so `load_vendor_shape` does not place it.
